tools.name: search
tools.description: Search docs.bithuman.ai (bitHuman real-time avatar SDKs, the REST API, deployment options, models, pricing). Returns JSON {results: [{id, title, url, section, text}]}, most relevant first (default 8, at most 20); `text` is a short snippet, so pass the `id` to `fetch` for the whole page. Example: {"q

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one docs page as markdown by the id `search` returned (a path such as /platforms/python), or by its full docs.bithuman.ai URL. Returns JSON {id, title, text (the whole page as markdown), url, metadata}. Example: {"id": "/api/agents"}. Errors: an unknown path (run `search` for the id) and a URL

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
